infobox.usage: Unlocks the observation room in The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Observation room key (Observe) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens one of the personnel workstation rooms in the Labyrinth. That room may have something to do with the research that took place in the Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Labyrinth

sections.heading: The Labyrinth
sections.text: - In the hand of one of five lab technicians. Guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the observation room in The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables, Electronics, Tools, Stimulants, Meds)
- Labrys research notes spawns
